Associate Director, Legal Services - Construction

  • Oxford Properties Group
  • Toronto, Ontario, Canada
  • Nov 12, 2026

Job Description

Hybrid, at least 4 days per week in the office. Lead legal support for design and construction work including RFPs, architectural agreements and CCDC documents. Draft, review and negotiate commercial contracts such as building service agreements, operational and consultant agreements. Advise on operational, regulatory and compliance issues and review disputes. Contribute to the risk and compliance framework. Manage outside counsel. Licensed to practice law in Ontario with at least 3 years of relevant experience in-house or at a law firm specializing in construction contracts. Full-time permanent role.
